title: Full dynamic E3 response-space safeguarded outer coupling in one prepared solve
question: Can a complete dynamic outer coupling loop reproduce the frozen G17 safeguarded solution inside one continuously evolving F-GC38 prepared solve by recomputing the qualified research E3 tangent at each accepted coupling head and applying the unchanged P4 factor-1/2 acceptance logic in affine-response space rather than by controlling MODFLOW X directly?

separation.research_subject: Dynamic multi-outer response-space globalization using G16/E3 observations and one live prepared MODFLOW solve.
not_claimed: Production admission of E3, response-space damping or P4.
Equivalence outside the frozen affine G11 groundwater stress.
Compatibility with the fixed-slope first F-GC39 production coupling contract.

algorithm_contract: Open exactly one live MODFLOW6 prepared timestep and one prepared solve; capture fixed accepted XOLD.
Maintain a coupling-head authority h_k. At the initial outer state this is the frozen G11 reference head; after every accepted response phase it is the settled live MODFLOW X head.
At h_k obtain the current real-SWAP observation through G16 and compute the interface residual against the frozen G19 affine groundwater authority G(h)=a*h+b.

Convergence requires both an already-settled MODFLOW response state and |q_swap-G(h)| <= 1e-15 m/s. The initial h0 is an initialization reference, not a claim that MODFLOW X has already converged there.
If not converged, compute E3 dynamically from G16 at h_k using the unchanged G09D/G13 scale ladder, execution-class rules and adjacent-scale 5% gate.
For the current outer state define q_lambda(h_k)=G(h_k)+lambda*r_k with the newly computed physical tangent p_k held fixed within that outer safeguard sequence.
Start each outer safeguard sequence at lambda=1. Publish the corresponding affine response and continue the same prepared solve until MODFLOW reports convergence.
Observe SWAP diagnostically at the settled head. Accept only when participant status is 0 and the absolute interface residual does not exceed |r_k|+1e-18 m/s.
On rejection, halve lambda and republish/re-solve inside the same prepared solve. Do not restore, prescribe or directly mutate X; do not reset XOLD; do not reopen the prepared solve.
After an accepted response, advance h_k to that settled head, recompute current SWAP response and E3 on the next outer update, and allow the tangent slope/mode/scale to change.
At final conjunctive convergence finalize_solve exactly once and stop before finalize_time_step.
quantitative_gates: Exactly one prepare_time_step and one prepare_solve are used for the whole G21 loop.
Accepted XOLD is bitwise unchanged after every MODFLOW solve call; the session remains open and non-invalid until final finalize_solve.
No direct X/XOLD assignment, setter, restore, rollback, reopen or prepared-solve reconstruction is used.
The first lambda=1 settled response reproduces the G17 raw head within 1e-12 m and has participant status 6.
The first outer safeguard performs exactly two lambda halvings; its accepted head agrees with G17 outer-1 accepted head within 1e-12 m.
Outer 2 and outer 3 accept lambda=1 without contraction and their accepted heads each agree with the corresponding G17 accepted head within 1e-12 m.
The response-attempt participant-status sequence is exactly [6,6,0,0,0].
Total safeguard contractions equal 2 and accepted outer updates equal 3.

At each outer update E3 returns AVAILABLE; selected mode and selected scale equal the corresponding frozen G17 trace values. Relative tangent-slope difference from the frozen G17 value must be <= 1e-4.
Final head agrees with G17 within 1e-12 m and final absolute interface residual is <= 1e-15 m/s.
All G16 observations remain diagnostic: no live participant candidate, FMR preflight or ledger preflight survives any observation; accepted revision/time/committed ledger remain unchanged.
All MODFLOW response attempts occur inside the same MXITER-bounded prepared solve. No exact total solve-call count is preregistered.
Exactly one finalize_solve and zero finalize_time_step calls occur.
No production runtime or adapter source is changed.
pass_interpretation: PASS qualifies a bounded full research outer-coupling algorithm for the frozen G11 affine-groundwater stress: dynamic E3 plus P4-equivalent response-space damping can reproduce the G17 accepted path inside one continuous prepared MODFLOW solve without direct groundwater state control. It does not admit this policy to production or modify F-GC39.
fail_interpretation: Preserve failure. Do not weaken E3 class/scale rules, tangent comparison, P4 merit/status acceptance, lambda-halving sequence, G17 reference heads, MODFLOW continuous-X ownership, convergence tolerance or path-equivalence requirements.
